# cmd

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-controller/cmd"
```

main.go is the controller's process entry point.

It builds the runtime scheme \(bootstrap.RegisterSchemes, run from init\), constructs the controller\-runtime manager, builds this controller's Runtime \(internal/runtime\), and registers the CQRS controllers, observers, and build subsystem through internal/bootstrap before starting the manager.

## type Runtime

Runtime describes read access to the core engine's Engine, Cache, Events, and Registry subsystems.

```go
type Runtime interface {
    Engine() *engine.Engine
    Cache() *cache.Cache
    Events() *events.EventRecorder
    Registry() *registry.Registry
}
```
